title: Upgrade @objectstack packages to 0.8.0
body:
Upgrades @objectstack core packages from 0.7.2 to 0.8.0 across the monorepo. Version 0.8.0 introduces Zod v4 with stricter type validation.

## Changes

- **Dependency bumps** (14 files): `@objectstack/{cli,core,driver-memory,objectql,plugin-msw,runtime,client,spec}` → `0.8.0`
  - Root devDependencies
  - apps/console dependencies
  - examples/* (crm-app, todo, crm, msw-todo, kitchen-sink)
  - packages/* (react, types, core, data-objectstack)

- **Removed patches**: `patches/@objectstack__core*.patch`
  - Previous patches added `registerPlugin()`/`boot()` aliases for `use()`/`bootstrap()`
  - No longer needed; codebase already uses canonical APIs

## Protocol compatibility

No code changes required. Existing usage of `ObjectKernel.use()` and `.bootstrap()` is correct:

```typescript
const kernel = new ObjectKernel();
kernel
  .use(new ObjectQLPlugin())
  .use(new DriverPlugin(driver, 'memory'))
  .use(new AppPlugin(config));
  
await kernel.bootstrap();
```

Version 0.8.0 primarily upgrades validation internals (Zod v3 → v4) without API surface changes.
